general.title: 1. General Information
general.text: The «Vyrij» Choir website respects your privacy. We do not collect or process users’ personal data.

notCollected.title: 2. What data we do NOT collect
items: No analytical cookies (Google Analytics or similar)
No IP addresses or device data are collected

images.title: 3. Content with people’s images
images.intro: The «Gallery» section contains photos of choir members:
list: All photos were taken at public events (concerts, rehearsals)
Choir members have given consent to publish these photos
If you recognize yourself in a photo and wish to have it removed:
images.note: Please include: page URL and photo description

gdpr.title: 5. Your GDPR rights
list: Request deletion of a photo with your image (response within 14 days)
Obtain information about data related to you

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By using the vyrij.org website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with them - please do not use the site.

paragraphs: All materials on the site belong to the Vyrij choir, including:
list: photos from concerts, rehearsals and other public events;
video materials;
texts and event descriptions;
Vyrij choir logo.
intellectualProperty.restrictedTitle: Prohibited without written consent of the Vyrij choir:

liability.title: 4. Liability Limitation
paragraphs: The site is provided "as is". The Vyrij choir does not guarantee:
list: uninterrupted operation of the site;
accuracy of archival materials (e.g., descriptions of past events);
correctness or safety of third-party resources that may be linked to.

confidentiality.title: 5. Confidentiality
paragraphs: The vyrij.org website does not use cookies and does not collect users' personal data.

changes.title: 6. Terms Changes
paragraphs: The Vyrij choir reserves the right to change these terms. The updated version is always available on this page. Changes may be made in particular:
list: when adding new services (e.g., online ticket sales);
when changes occur in Polish legislation (e.g., Consumer Rights Act).
